Context keys are invocation inputs. Dotted options keys select properties of the caller's options argument. dateRange, options.dateRange, range1 and range2 preserve their original receiving scopes. Internal calls use their call-site operands and source defaults.

A call summary preserves its normal return and named boundary effects. Uncaught throws or rejections terminate that invocation before subsequent instructions. Earlier requests, logs or writes may already have occurred. A return with completion=throw is an abrupt exit.

An API acquisition takes the handle as method receiver, the request as its argument and the external resource as the source of the reply. A cast preserves the acquired value. Cached handles retain creation-time credentials or auth. A fresh handle is a distinct value. Cache effects depend on the actual getter outcome.

Writes use replace as the storage abstraction. A write has no file-content output. saveResult returns the path after the write succeeds. Analysis producers discard that path. A later content read acquires the selected file as it exists at read time.

The Skill specifies installation in scripts, a project-root .env, the Analytics Data, Search Console and Indexing APIs enabled, and service-account access to the GA4 property and Search Console. skill/SKILL.md:8–26.

The Skill requires analysis, automatic timestamped JSON saving, and then reading saved JSON and creating Markdown under results/summaries/ with tables, trends and recommendations. The tip to request summaries also remains in the source. skill/SKILL.md:53–64,118–142,152–155.
